critical.issue: Returns empty array [] for Ayu even though she has active sales orders and 3 SORD special orders for Toko Kain Sejahtera and KSC/SO-00003/00004 for Butik Bali Indah/Toko Kain Sejahtera. Empty list blocks mobile Pesanan Khusus save (od-customer dropdown has no choices). Per task spec ('sales may create orders for customers assigned to other sales; credit viewable at checkout'), /api/customers for sales should include at least customers for whom the sales has own-orders — same union rule as collection worklist.

minor.issue: Returns 404 instead of 403 for cross-sales customer where sales has NO own-order relationship (e.g. Ayu→cust_toko_tekstil_pasar_baru). Pytest asserts 403 (passed via cross-entity path). Functionally denied, but inconsistent status code could confuse clients.

ui_bugs.issue: Both are shadcn Popover+Command/DatePicker buttons; test helpers must click open then click day/option (not fill()). This is fine design-wise but worth noting for test automation parity.

integration_issues.issue: Save impossible because customer picker is empty — root cause GET /api/customers returns [] for Ayu. Save button stays disabled with 'Belum lengkap: pelanggan'.

return-order-select is empty (data-kn-empty=true) because no Ayu SO is in a return-eligible shipped/received state. Precondition: whadmin/admin must process picking+shipping for one of Ayu's SOs (e.g. KSC/SO-00003 or KSC/SO-00004) before mobile return save can be exercised.

action_items: FIX /api/customers for role=sales to include customers from the sales' own-orders union (same rule as /api/sales/collection worklist and can_collect_customer / can_view_credit). Without this, Mobile Pesanan Khusus save is impossible for Ayu — even though she already has 3 SORD for Toko Kain Sejahtera.
SEED a return-eligible SO for Ayu (pick+ship one of KSC/SO-00003 or KSC/SO-00004 via whadmin desktop) so Mobile Return save can be verified end-to-end next iteration.
Consider aligning credit-status denial code: 404 for sales-with-no-relationship vs 403 for cross-entity — both deny, but pick one for API consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: GET /api/sales/order-dashboard correctly ignores sales_id spoof for role=sales (Ayu vs Kanda numbers differ, cross-check with pytest).
Positive: Collection worklist's own-order rule works end-to-end — m-collection-own-<id> badges render and mark/followup succeed without 403.
Positive: Credit-status at checkout for own-order customer (Toko Kain Sejahtera as Ayu) returns 200.

Gap: Customer list visibility is asymmetric. Sales can place orders for a customer (checkout), see credit-status (200), see collection reminders (own-order rule), but CANNOT list that customer in /api/customers — breaking the Pesanan Khusus create flow which filters its combobox from /api/customers. Fix should centralize the 'customers_in_sales_scope' resolver (assigned OR has own-order) and reuse in /api/customers, worklist, credit-status, special-order form.

Minor: od-customer-option-empty is auto-selected as the sole visible item when customer list is empty — this masks the real emptiness. Better UX: show explicit 'Belum ada pelanggan tersedia untuk Anda. Hubungi admin.' empty-state in od-customer-listbox.

rca of the issue: Pesanan Khusus save BLOCKER RCA: special-order-form's customer combobox is populated from GET /api/customers (confirmed via network capture — one 200 /api/customers before dropdown opens, 0-length JSON). Backend /api/customers filter for role=sales uses assigned_sales_id only, excluding customers the sales has own-orders for. Collection worklist/credit-status use can_collect_customer/can_view_credit (own-order union). The two scopes should match. Mitigation: expand /api/customers list query for role=sales to UNION {assigned_sales_id==user.id} with {customers that appear in any sales_order where created_by_sales_id==user.id or sales_id==user.id}. Return save BLOCKER RCA: no Ayu order is in a return-eligible status (0 shipped per dashboard); return-order-select renders data-kn-empty=true. Mitigation: as whadmin, run picking + shipping on one Ayu SO on desktop (/whadmin/sales-orders → KSC/SO-00003), then re-run this iteration's return save script.
